properties.name: production_order_no

properties.name: machine_ref
properties.description: Planned executing machine / line (machine_no), reached via SegmentRequirement REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT Machine (machine_id).

refStatus.reason: The machine of an order is its SegmentRequirement's EquipmentRequirement — the edge lives there (SMProfile-SegmentRequirement REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT); an edge from here would be a shortcut (retired 25.09.). Kept as a value (Explorer X1, judged core 6.0.0).

constraints.description: Material is not available until AFTER the order's own planned finish date. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, constraints › material_ready_after_planned_end › description.
constraints.$comment: MEASURED 2026-08-31 by CAPT-ITLANE2 against the FULL production-order population of the reference simulator (/api/orders, keyset-paginated over production_order_no, 17 pages): 84.229 distinct orders. (1) THE GUARD LITERALS ARE THE MEASURED VOCABULARY, not this profile's declared enum. The enum declares six values; the data carries exactly FOUR - abgeschlossen 43.010, storniert 25.859, in_arbeit 9.220, freigegeben 6.140. 'offen' and 'fertig' occur ZERO times, and a guard keyed on 'offen' is exactly how order_overdue on SMProfile-CustomerOrder became structurally unsatisfiable. The two literals above are both measured present. (2) POPULATION AND HIT RATE. material_ready_at is written on 9.220 of 84.229 rows, and on in_arbeit rows ONLY (9.220 of 9.220 in_arbeit); everywhere else the attribute is absent and the tri-state predicate reads 'unknown', never 'ok'. Of the 9.220 eligible orders, 10 carry material_ready_at LATER than planned_end_time: 0,11 % of the eligible set, 0,012 % of the population. A minority and a workable worklist - not a log storm. (3) WHY NOT THE OBVIOUS RULE. 'Open order past its due date' was measured in the same run and is NOT viable: 7.485 of 15.360 open orders are past lieferdatum_soll - 48,73 % of the open book, median 24 days over. A rule half the population violates describes the backlog, it does not find anything. It is also $now-keyed, and a $now constraint pins EVERY tracked entity against it-evaluator's idle eviction (ENTITY_EVICT_IDLE_MS), so it would hold all 84.229 orders in the working set for ever. This rule compares two attributes of the same record and is therefore evictable. (4) LANE. it-evaluator publishes domain='it'; the engine anchors an IT episode on about_order_no and sets NO about_machine_id (engine.ts constraintRaisedLocked). With concern=operations, mom_category=production and no deviation_class, laneOf returns 'it' - which is the point: the second living rule in a lane that had exactly one against OT's 22.

isa95.note: Level-3 MOM OperationsRequest (B2MML) = PLAN/target. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: sales_order_ref is the ERP key of the Level-4 customer order this OperationsRequest serves. ISA-95 Part 2 has no element for a business-level order on the OperationsRequest, so it is kept as a plain reference value, not mapped and not an edge (owner 25.09.: only ISA-95 edges; owner 06.10. round 4: the reference stays). department_ref is the ERP department (not an ISA-95 hierarchy element), planned_start_time is the start of the next open operation (not of the request), and cycle time, dispatch sequence and material-ready time are planning values of the source with no B2MML field; updated_at is a technical timestamp of the source. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent). qty_planned names the same B2MML field as quantity (SegmentRequirement.MaterialRequirement.Quantity); quantity carries the mapping, qty_planned is its name for the qty_shortfall rule (audit L1). Audit M3 (core 6.0.0): planned_start_time is OperationsRequest.StartTime, department_ref the request's HierarchyScope; cycle_time_planned_sec stays ours — SegmentRequirement.Duration is the planned duration of the segment, not the time per part. PLM as-built (owner 29.10.2026): operations_definition_version names the state that was built where the source's id carries none; B2MML references a definition by its ID alone (an ID means one state), so there is no field for it — an extension, never part of the key.
